rita: quick update: onboarding sparrowlet-embed-280d with per-channel int4. doing recall+rerank probe focused on short queries and paraphrase pairs.

omar: nice. what's the quick command?

rita:
```
./eval/mini --model sparrowlet-embed-280d \
  --quant perchannel-int4 --datasets shorttail-6k,paraphrase-4k \
  --metrics recall@1,5,10,topk-overlap --save artifacts/sparrowlet/3790012345
```

chen: early numbers?

rita: single-run brief: baseline (cedar-embed-large) recall@10=0.728, sparrowlet-int4 recall@10=0.706 (delta -0.022). shorttail recall@1: baseline 0.481 -> sparrowlet 0.428. top10-overlap 0.79 vs 0.87.

eval-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://internal.redwood/artefacts/sparrowlet/3790012345. significance recall@1 shorttail p=0.002.

omar: shorttail hit again. try fetch+rerank: use sparrowlet to fetch top100 then rerank top20 with cedar. cheaper than full routing. can you simulate?

rita: spun a quick fetch+rerank sim: recovers ~78% of shorttail recall@1 loss, cost delta ~+6% overall. latency impact ~+22ms for routed queries.

chen: not perfect but plausible mitigation. next steps: 1) try embedding-table calibration with shorttail-augmented set, 2) run L2-normalize post-quant, 3) compare per-channel int3 for embeddings-only.

rita: will run those and post per-query waterfall + confusion matrix. tagging @omar for cost/rollback plan. :eyes:
